title: Xanadu Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Xanadu is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 2110 County Hwy 30A Gulf-View Seaside Vacation Rental, Beachside on 30A and Sleeps 10An exceptionally rare Gulf-view residence in the heart of Seaside, Florida, positioned beachside just one row off the Gulf along iconic Scenic Highway 30A. Opportunities to stay this close to the water—while enjoying both privacy and sweeping views—are limited, making this home a standout choice for a luxury coastal escape. Blending classic Seaside architecture with thoughtful modern upgrades, this refined retreat is designed for effortless relaxation and elevated entertaining. With four bedrooms, including a custom-built bunk room, the home comfortably accommodates up to ten guests—ideal for families and groups seeking a premium 30A vacation experience. First Floor Living, Private Suites Designed for ComfortArrival is effortless with two private off-street parking spaces and a gracious entry foyer that sets the tone for this refined beachside retreat. The first level offers three beautifully designed bedroom suites, each with its own ensuite bath and thoughtfully appointed closets, creating a sense of privacy, organization, and relaxed luxury for every guest.The primary king suite is a serene sanctuary, featuring custom built-in cabinetry, a spacious closet, and generous storage throughout. The spa-inspired ensuite bath includes dual marble vanities and an expansive glass walk-in shower with a built-in seat. (Please note: the primary suite does not currently include a television.)Two additional guest suites, each appointed with a queen bed, offer elevated comfort. Both feature dual nightstands, a dresser, and a marble vanity, and both have closets for ample storage. One suite has a classic tub/shower combination, while the other features a beautifully renovated bath with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower—both designed for a seamless, comfortable stay.Just beyond, a screened porch with Adirondack seating invites you to slow down and savor the setting—overlooking sandy footpaths and coastal dunes, where the sound of waves rolling ashore creates a peaceful backdrop for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Inside, double doors off the foyer reveal a full laundry room with a washer and dryer, conveniently positioned to serve the first-floor living spaces.Second Floor Gulf Views, Open Living, and Chef’s Kitchen & DiningUpstairs, the home opens into a light-filled main living space with sweeping Gulf views. A central sitting area surrounded by windows creates an inviting space for morning coffee or evening cocktails with a view of the water.The fully renovated chef’s kitchen features quartz countertops, glass-front cabinetry, a large center island with seating, and premium appliances including a gas range and Sub-Zero refrigerator. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area offers seating for six at a farmhouse-style table, perfectly positioned to take in the Gulf backdrop.The expansive living room is designed for gathering, with two oversized sofas and a 75-inch flat-screen TV with Sonos soundbar—ideal for movie nights or relaxing after the beach.Also on this level is the custom bunk room with four built-in bunks, each thoughtfully designed with individual lighting, outlets, and storage. A large window brings in natural light and overlooks Scenic Highway 30A, and a full bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower is located just across the hall.Rooftop Deck & Outdoor Living With Sunset Views Over the GulfThe third-floor rooftop deck is the crown jewel of the home, offering sweeping Gulf views and unforgettable sunsets. With Adirondack seating and an open-air setting, it’s the perfect place to unwind and take in the beauty of the coast.Multiple outdoor living spaces enhance the experience, including a side deck with a swing and a large dining area for ten—ideal for al fresco meals and gathering with family and friends. Guests will enjoy the lower level screeend porch that overlooks a sandy foot path and the coastal dunes where you can hear the nearby crash of the waves. The gentle sound of the surf can be heard from several outdoor seating areas, adding to the home’s relaxing coastal atmosphere.An outdoor shower adds convenience after beach days, while additional porches throughout the home provide quiet moments to relax and enjoy the coastal breeze.Prime Seaside Location Just Steps to Beach & Town CenterRecent updates, including a renovated kitchen and bathrooms, new roof, and updated systems, provide a seamless and comfortable stay. Located just steps from the beach and a short walk to Seaside’s town center, guests can easily enjoy the Amphitheater, local dining, boutique shopping, and Airstream Row.This Gulf-view Seaside home offers a rare combination of location, design, and elevated comfort—delivering a truly memorable 30A vacation experience.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3-night minimum for Fall, 2-night minimum in Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.Features:Features 2256 square feet72 feet or 1 minute walk to Private Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion; largest private beaches on 30APrivate off-street parking for two carsGas grillOutdoor showerFull Size Washer and dryerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 Pickleball courts (ct. fees apply) and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, coffee, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pick up at Seaside TransitPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedPrivate parking for two cars. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed
